name: ai.lipdub/lipdub-mcp
description: Lip-sync a video to a different audio track with LipDub 2 — submit a render, track it, and fetch the finished video.

environmentVariables.name: LIPDUB_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your LipDub API key, from Settings → API Keys at app.lipdub.ai (Owner or Admin only).

environmentVariables.name: LIPDUB_MAX_RENDERS_PER_SESSION
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling on how many renders this server will start in one session. Defaults to 5.

environmentVariables.name: LIPDUB_REQUIRE_SPEND_CONFIRMATION
environmentVariables.description: Whether a render must be explicitly confirmed before it spends credits. Defaults to true; set false only for headless pipelines.

environmentVariables.name: LIPDUB_API_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file containing the API key, as an alternative to LIPDUB_API_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: LIPDUB_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warn (the default) or error. Logs are written to stderr.
